query: Promote the Page.aspx on https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/Test to https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/Prod as Page-copy.aspx.
expected_behavior: Builds the plan with scripts/spo-page-copy-plan.ps1 -SourcePageUrl ... -TargetPageUrl ... and no -Execute
Identifies this as a cross-site copy and describes the Copy-PnPFile to the target SitePages folder followed by Rename-PnPFile
Does not run any live tenant write itself and leaves the real run (-Execute -ConfirmToken COPY-SPO-PAGE) to the user

query: Copy Page.aspx to Page-v2.aspx on the same site so I can iterate safely.
expected_behavior: Identifies a same-site copy and describes a single Copy-PnPFile to the full target path including the filename
Does not use the cross-site two-step copy-then-rename flow
Uses -Overwrite only if the user says the target may be replaced

query: Just upload my local Page.aspx file straight into Site Pages.
expected_behavior: Declines raw .aspx file upload and recommends the supported SPO page APIs and PnP promotion patterns
Notes a non-.aspx page name is also rejected
Does not run any write command
